author: user_01
text:
Have you ever lost it in public? What happened and how did you recover?

Update below.

I just raised my voice at a couple of old women who cut in front of me in line. There were people behind me who witnessed it and the clerk chastised me. 

I started thyroid medication and it makes me feel like I'm not on bipolar meds at all. I'm actually scared. 

Has anyone else had a public freakout? I'm fighting a shame spiral. 


UPDATE: 
I went and apologized to the cashier and it literally could not have gone better. 

First of all he had no idea who I was!! I said I wanted to apologize to him for what happened. He was confused about WTF I was talking about and then he busted into a huge smile and said, "oh. The old ladies!" And he laughed! I said OMG I'm sorry that was horrible and he just brushed it off with a huge smile and several times said. "It's ok! We all have bad days!" I said OMG. Have you ever done anything like that and he said,"not like that but I've done other things and it's ok, we all have bad days." 

I cannot believe this is the outcome. Not only did he not even remember me at first but he wasn't even phased. I was ready to never show my face there again and to him it was just a nothing. 

So I guess sometimes people are compassionate when they see us acting wild. 

I'm so thankful I decided to apologize even though I was scared as shit. Thanks so much everyone for the support ❤️❤️❤️

author: user_01
text:
I got demoted at work

I have been struggling with mood effects from thyroid medication since October. I've been at my job 9 years and this hasn't happened before.

Clients keep complaining about me. I make them uncomfortable with my vibe and catatonic tone so they imagine or blow up innocuous things. 

My boss knows my diagnosis but she's just mad. I wish she had checked in and asked if I need time off but instead she just demoted me. 

Once 2 years ago she got enraged at me over complaints but forgot about it right after. 

The thing is that she knows my situation and is kind of the main person who knows and I've had a delusion that she cares about me and understands.

But I've been a child. Not holding it together enough because I've felt entitled or just stopped caring. 

Acting perky to 20 people a day in 30min blocks is so hard when inside I'm screaming with rage and hatred and despair.

I just got a new therapist but I'm worried.

This is about my character and the choices I make, too. 

How much is the illness, and how much is me? Am I a hateful, angry, bitter person? How much of that would evaporate if I can get off my thyroid medication?

I got on it because I was catatonic and not living. I was sedated by the illness. Now I'm doing things but almost everything else is gone. 

I don't have other job options. I hate my job now but I'd lose my apartment and everything else. 

I'm scared I'm sabotaging.

  
Thanks for reading. I hope someone can understand

author: user_04
text:
How long to recover from SSRI

I got diagnosed last year after taking SSRIs and having rapid cycling, 1-2 weeks depressed followed by 1-2 weeks hypomanic. It was horrible, borderline ruined my life. 

Now I’m medicated (lamictal and latuda) and even though I’m a lot more stable, my moods still follow the same pattern (just with less intensity in either direction). 

It’s been about 8 months since I stopped the SSRI (I was on it for about 2 months). I’m nervous that this is my new baseline. Has anyone been through this period as well? If so did your moods really recover ever ?
